gloss: no vacancy; fully booked; all rooms occupied

definitions.gloss: no vacancy; fully booked; all rooms occupied
definitions.explanation: A state in which all rooms in a hotel, inn, or similar facility are occupied and no more guests can be accommodated.

examples.japanese: ⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{満室|まんしつ}だった。
{連休中|れんきゅうちゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どこ→どこ：00539_doko⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{満室|まんしつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れない→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。
examples.english: During the holiday period, everywhere is fully booked and I can't make a reservation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{旅館|りょかん}→旅館：01049_ryokan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{満室|まんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Popular inns can be fully booked as early as six months in advance.

notes:
USAGE:
Commonly seen on signs at hotels and parking garages (for the latter, ⟦{満車|まんしゃ}→満車：15487_mansha⟧ is used instead). The opposite is ⟦{空室|くうしつ}→空室：14798_kuushitsu⟧ (vacancy).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {満室|まんしつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (to become fully booked)
- {満室|まんしつ}{御礼|おんれい} (fully booked — thank you)
- ⟦{空室|くうしつ}→空室：14798_kuushitsu⟧/{満室|まんしつ} (vacancy / no vacancy)

SIMILAR WORDS:
⟦{満車|まんしゃ}→満車：15487_mansha⟧ (no parking spaces available), ⟦{満席|まんせき}→満席：07585_manseki⟧ (no seats available), ⟦{満員|まんいん}→満員：07584_manin⟧ (full capacity of people).
